scope: Dry-run-first environment Gateway API-key to PostgreSQL tenant-scope provisioner
contracts_checked: Raw keys are held only while parsing and are never retained in manifest representations or output
Only strong keys with exact resource/action/canonical-location scopes enter the database manifest
The default database session is read-only and does not lock or insert rows
Apply mode uses a separate operator-supplied DSN and concurrent-safe create-only inserts containing hashes, prefixes, and exact scopes
Concurrent insert conflicts are re-read and accepted only when the stored row exactly matches
Matching active, unexpired rows are idempotent; drift, inactive rows, and expired rows fail closed
The command never updates, reactivates, or implicitly revokes existing credentials
Runtime role boundary checks continue to deny API-key writes
limitations: Tests use synthetic manifests and database fakes; no candidate or legacy database was accessed
The encrypted maintenance DSN and actual tenant-scoped environment keys remain deployment inputs
